name: Village
variant: Gears 5 — Operation 8, intérieur cérémoniel adapté au combat 2D
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one widescreen raster master background for a 2D side-view fighting game. Recreate the ceremonial interior of VILLAGE from GEARS 5 OPERATION 8, using the supplied official gameplay screenshot as the visual reference. Keep the very specific architecture and materials: four massive deeply carved wooden columns, the open rear wall framing a tall narrow carved totem with a palm-blade-shaped crown, stepped timber platforms lined with small pale candles, two low square braziers with orange fire, suspended woven spherical orange lanterns, carved timber rails and wall panels, moss, hanging vines, and cool blue-teal jungle light through the openings. Preserve the central ornate rectangular altar with its round inset bronze disc and patterned gold front; place it and the braziers behind the gameplay plane. The visual identity must match the supplied Gears 5 screenshot, including its weathered timber, carved patterns, lighting, proportions, and asymmetric foliage. Compose a single coherent 16:9 panorama, head-on with minimal perspective distortion, a level continuous unobstructed horizontal floor band across the lower 20 percent for two fighters. Keep the central totem and main columns fully visible. Realistic detailed game-background painting with natural textures, crisp materials, warm candle and lantern light against the cool blue background. No characters, creatures, UI, labels, added text, watermarks, collage, or split panels. No redesign of the main structures; any necessary extension at the sides must continue the observed timber structure. This output is one flattened stage master, not separated parallax layers. Aim for a high-resolution widescreen image.

sources.scope: Capture officielle de l’intérieur de la map Village, Gears 5 Operation 8 ; seule référence fournie au générateur.
Présentation de production de Dylan Abernethy confirmant sa contribution à Village ; contexte documentaire, non utilisée comme image d’entrée.

observations: Quatre colonnes de bois sculpté, totem central à couronne en palmes, autel rectangulaire au disque circulaire, braseros, bougies, lanternes tressées et végétation reprennent la capture officielle.
La bande de sol inférieure est dégagée pour le combat latéral ; aucun personnage ni interface.
Les deux côtés, les motifs sculptés et certaines proportions ont été recomposés ; correspondance géométrique exacte non certifiée.
remaining_checks: Comparer les sculptures, le nombre de lanternes et les rapports de dimensions avec plusieurs vues du niveau final.
Produire séparément arrière-plan, colonnes, autel, sol et premier plan ; le PNG est un master aplati.
Établir l’échelle des combattants et les limites du plan de combat dans la scène jouable.
